mapper.select: select id from users where id = #{userId} for update
mapper.delete: delete from follows where follower_id = #{followerId} and following_id = #{followingId}
delete from user_feed_entries where user_id = #{followerId} and author_user_id = #{followingId}
mapper.update: update follows set notify_new_content = #{notifyNewContent}, muted = #{muted}, updated_at = current_timestamp where follower_id = #{followerId} and following_id = #{followingId}
update user_social_stats set following_count = case when following_count > 0 then following_count - 1 else 0 end, updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId}
update user_social_stats set follower_count = case when follower_count > 0 then follower_count - 1 else 0 end, updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into user_feed_entries (user_id, content_id, author_user_id, score) select #{followerId}, c.id, c.author_user_id, coalesce(c.publish_time, 0) from content_items c where c.author_user_id = #{followingId} and c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and not exists ( select 1 from user_feed_entries existing where existing.user_id = #{followerId} and existing.content_id = c.id ) order by c.publish_time desc, c.id desc limit #{limit}
